card.name: "To ensure" in opioid REMS statements
card.fires_on: The word "ensure" right after "To" at the start of the opioid analgesic REMS paragraph. It also fires weakly on a comma after "sense pain" in a patient leaflet.

modes.label: REMS opening
modes.description: "ensure" following "To" just after the heading Opioid Analgesic Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS).
modes.example: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) To<< ensure>> that the benefits of opioid analgesics

modes.label: Pain-sensing comma
modes.description: A comma after "can't sense pain" in a leaflet about a child with reduced feeling in the limbs.
modes.example: and can't sense pain<<,>> he or she may get injured and not

card.plain: It marks the stock sentence that opens the opioid REMS section: "To ensure that the benefits of opioid analgesics..."
